convert_diffusers_to_sdxl_checkpoint: convert a HF Diffusers SDXL pipeline to a Stable Diffusion checkpoint using --model_path and --checkpoint_path
convert_unet_state_dict: convert a Diffusers UNet state dict to original Stable Diffusion SDXL format using convert_unet_state_dict
convert_vae_state_dict: convert a Diffusers VAE state dict to original Stable Diffusion SDXL format using convert_vae_state_dict
convert_openclip_text_enc_state_dict: convert an OpenCLIP text encoder state dict to original SDXL format using convert_openclip_text_enc_state_dict
reshape_weight_for_sd: reshape HF linear weights to SD conv2d weights using reshape_weight_for_sd
